pr_body:
Closes #83582

One little detail is that the `LIFECYCLE_NAME` value is defined on [IndexMetadata](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/83603/files#diff-d9e713c7c9f70d3b97888b7ed019ba4469397004333b0d0c13fa98442beef047R822) but it's still almost entirely referenced by way of [LifecycleSettings](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/83603/files#diff-4e8f046e86e7ec85e51de358c9773903205bebc9b34afacaab5d7d479837a39cR20). We need to have the value available in IndexMetadata in order to pull the value from the settings and set it into `lifecyclePolicyName`, but besides that everything about this still seems more `LifecycleSettings`-related to me.
pr_title: Cache ILM policy name on IndexMetadata
